title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Hold Rates by Delinquency Stage
content:
**Collections schedule — hold rate by delinquency stage, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease end-of-term balances**

**Schedule.** The hold rate set by the delinquency stage of the end-of-term invoice is:

| Days since the invoice due date | Stage | Hold rate |
|---|---|---|
| more than 30, up to and including 45 | early stage | 25 percent |
| more than 45, up to and including 60 | mid stage | 35 percent |
| more than 60 | later stage | 50 percent |

**Counting.** The invoice due date is the mailing date of the lease's end-of-term invoice — the latest mailing date where there is more than one invoice — plus the end-of-term payment period of 30 calendar days. The days since the due date are counted from the day after the due date through today.

**Boundary days (hypothetical due date June 30)**

| Today | Days since the due date | Hold rate |
|---|---|---|
| August 14 | 45 | 25 percent |
| August 15 | 46 | 35 percent |
| August 29 | 60 | 35 percent |
| August 30 | 61 | 50 percent |
